'''Debris nets''' were a tool utilized by [[Construction droid/Legends|construction droids]]. [[EVS Construction Droid]]s were equipped with debris nets alongside [[collector trowel]]s, [[explosive electrical claw]]s, [[plasma cutter]]s, [[implosion wrecking ball]]s, and an [[atomic incinerator]].<ref name="EGTD" />
